Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 4.2-4.4, 7.4; landing 6. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: post-M1 / extended capability.
Integration parent: bd-01M1C2A5HGJ0MM1X7N8Z5EAZBD; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M1C2TV1SJECKEQ6SNVSRBTHQ.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own consumer capability review/adoption for rich source exploration. Reuse checked source/Atlas/Codex structure already present in StoryModel; identify the exact public provider projection needed for categorical score/hierarchy, contexts, roles, relations and evidence. Do not create a second ontology or presume existing discourse coordinates permit a new layout.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Record exact producer API/revision, capability dispositions, generated fixtures and independent expected hierarchy/context/role/support results.
2. Draft/admitted source relation and non-metric layout permission are checked; missing summaries remain excerpts/IDs and missing relations are not invented.
3. If a required public capability is absent, mark this local gate blocked with precise upstream handoff before implementing dependent UI; no foreign dependency edge or silent substitute.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Retain existing Codex/discourse Atlas and sparse outline; no forced provider-pin upgrade.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [Story] Qualify supplied hierarchy, contexts and relation capabilities
